verdict.rationale: No first-party acceptable-use or anti-abuse policy appears in the pack; the stealth docs only describe bypassing bot detection. The only sign of a published posture is a community report that Hyperbrowser added an 'ethical scraping' docs page. The same reporters say the service does not respect robots.txt and that users cannot follow robots.txt or limit request rates, so the posture appears thin and unenforced. Missing for 10: a first-party acceptable-use/anti-abuse policy document, explicit rules on permitted uses of stealth and CAPTCHA features, enforcement or opt-out mechanisms such as robots.txt compliance and rate limits, and independent corroboration.
